'''Cadabra2: Field-Theoretic Tensor Computer Algebra'''
[[Category:Principia Machina]] [[Category:Tools]]

== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
'''Cadabra2''' is a field-theoretic computer algebra system specifically designed for tensor calculus, field theory, differential geometry, and variational action principles.

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM & SVD ==
* '''Action Functional Variation (9.5/10):''' Natively evaluates functional action derivatives:
<math display="block">\frac{\delta S}{\delta \phi_i} = 0</math>
for multi-field Lagrangians containing continuous scalar, vector, and tensor quantities.
* '''Covariant & Contravariant Tensor Algebra:''' Handles implicit index contractions, Riemann curvature tensors, Ricci scalars, Gamma matrices, and non-commuting Grassmann algebras.
* '''Noether Symmetry Evaluation:''' Automatically verifies whether a continuous candidate Lagrangian density <math>\mathcal{L}</math> invariant under global or local gauge transformations yields conserved Noether currents.
